name: Hashima Chiho
source:
She is the childhood friend of Hidehito.
They were both accepted into the same university and moved to Tokyo together.
Although she acts like an older sister toward Hidehito, she harbors feelings for him that go beyond those of a childhood friend.
Hidehito, however, thinks of her as a younger sister and is unaware of her feelings.
After a certain incident, she gives up on Hidehito and begins dating Yuusei, a senior at their university who had been pursuing her, but…
